lines: Seat 1 chooses Weaver: at the end, 1 point per 2 tiles in your largest connected group beyond the first 2, up to 3.
Seat 2 chooses Wildheart: at the end, 1 point per Wild tile held, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Steady tile at (-1, 2) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 3 mana on the Wild tile at (0, 2) (yields 1).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 wins the Wild tile at (0, 2) (yields 1) for 3 mana.
A tie for the Steady tile at (-1, 2) (yields 2) at 3 mana: nobody gets it.
Seat 1 gets the Shifting tile at (-2, 2) (yields 1) for free.
Seat 3 gets the Steady tile at (-1, 2) (yields 2) for free.
Bid 2 mana on the Shifting tile at (0, 1) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 4 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 4 mana on the Shifting tile at (0, 1) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 4 and keep 5 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 1 wins the Shifting tile at (0, 1) (yields 2) for 4 mana.
Seat 2 gets the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2) for free.
Seat 3 gets the Wild tile at (-1, -1) (yields 1) for free.
Bid 2 mana on the Shifting tile at (0, 0) (yields 1).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 3 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 3 mana on the Wild tile at (1, -1) (yields 3).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 3 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 1 wins the Shifting tile at (0, 0) (yields 1) for 2 mana.
Seat 2 wins the Wild tile at (1, -1) (yields 3) for 3 mana.
Seat 3 gets the Steady tile at (0, -2) (yields 2) for free.
The opening is over. The rounds begin.
Every trait stays secret until the end. Guess a rival's alongside your orders, once per rival.
Round 1 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 4 mana.
Seat 2 collects 6 mana.
Seat 3 collects 5 mana.
Attune the Wild tile at (1, 1) (yields 4) for 4 mana, leaving 5. If a rival attunes it too, nobody gets it.
